info.title: QAuth Admin API
info.description: The admin API of QAuth (ADR-019 Decision 7), served on the internal admin listener only. Every operation needs a DPoP-bound admin token, sent as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` with a proof made with its key for this listener's base URL and the request's path, whose account holds a grant on the realm in the path; a security operation also needs an approval bound to it.

servers.description: The admin listener, at ADMIN_API_BASE_URL. A proof's `htu` is that URL followed by the request's path.

dpopAuth.description: A DPoP-bound admin access token (RFC 9449 §7.1): `Authorization: DPoP <token>`, and a `DPoP` header holding a proof signed with the key the token names in `cnf.jkt`, for the request's method, ADMIN_API_BASE_URL followed by the request's path, an `iat` within 60 seconds, the token's hash as `ath` and a `jti` never used before. A Bearer token is refused.
